caption: The image depicts a black-and-white drawing or photograph of a decorative metal relief panel. The panel is vertically oriented with an ornate, arched top featuring swirling patterns and the stylized head of a snake or dragon at each upper corner. A border with a beaded effect and leafy patterns frames the central scene. In the center of the panel, there is a figure wearing a long dress, seated or standing beside a table or railing, with a halo or circular shape around the head. The left side of the panel shows an object that resembles a rake or farming tool leaning against the railing, and to the left of the figure there is a ladder-like structure and a round object. On the table next to the figure, there is a vase or container with flowers or foliage. Above the figure are the letters "FRVH" on the left and "LING" on the right, separated by the figure's head and halo. The relief is rendered in shades of gray and has a three-dimensional appearance due to its sculpted surface. The background of the image is a plain and light color, emphasizing the darker, textured panel.
title: Pa. German Fireback
